sentences.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
S.B. Criminal Misc(Pet.) No. 1906/2023 Deepak Kumar Kakra S/o Premsukh Kakra, Aged About 41 Years,

R/o 6 G 170 Kudi Bhagtasani Housing Board Jodhpur City West Raj.
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. The Superintendent Of Police, Jodhpur 3.

The S.h.o., Kudi Bhagtasani Jodhpur City West  ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Anil Bidan Halu on behalf of  Mr. Kailash Meghwal For Respondent(s) : Mr. M.S. Bhati, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 21/04/2023

The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner with the limited prayer that the Investigating Agency may be directed to conduct fair and proper investigation in FIR No.321/2022 lodged at Police Station Kudi Bhagtasni, Distt. Jodhpur City West for offence under Sections 420 and 406 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Kudi Bhagtasni, Distt. Jodhpur City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: After hearing the counsel for the petitioner and on an overall consideration of the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court deems it proper to direct the petitioner to submit a representation alongwith relevant documents before the concerned Superintendent of Police and Investigating Officer, within a period of fifteen days, who shall consider and decide the [2023/RJJD/011440] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-1906/2023] representation of the petitioner strictly in accordance with law within a period of four weeks from the date of filing of the representation.
The present misc. petition stands disposed of accordingly.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 56-Ishan/-
